name: Build a clear sponsorship decision brief
why: Shows how a sponsor judges a deal (cost, audience fit, a capped pilot), so pitches answer those questions first.

name: Build a prospect list, rank it and send first messages
why: Ranks prospects and writes checked first messages, the shape of a sponsor first wave.

name: Cold outreach batch runner
why: Runs each weekly batch of sponsor pitches from last batch's results, for the client to approve and send.

name: Follow-up email sequence writer
why: Gives every follow-up a new reason, one ask and a stop rule.

name: Turn a sales call into a checked proposal
why: Turns a sponsor call into a follow-up, a costed proposal and a dated plan to signature.

name: Pitch deck 10/20/30 checker
why: Checks a sponsorship deck for length, talk time and readable slides.

name: Write a short pitch and fix it after every no
why: Sharpens the pitch after each sponsor says no, with the hard objections answered.

name: Prepare a partner launch announcement pack
why: Gets both brands saying the same thing when a new sponsor is announced, with an approval tracker.

name: Plan an event follow up that earns a reply
why: Turns event notes into sponsor and guest follow-ups, with every promise tracked.

name: Monthly renewal watcher
why: Lists contracts up for renewal in the next 90 days with a plan for each call, useful for sponsor renewals.

name: Honest appreciation note writer
why: Writes a sponsor thank-you with one true detail and no ask.
